panel.title: Environments
panel.emptyHint: Define separate variable sets for your development, test and production environments and switch between them with one click.

globals.title: Globals
globals.description: Variables that apply to all requests in the workspace. They have the lowest priority; Environment and collection variables override them.

dialog.title: Environment: {name}
dialog.description: Variables that apply in this environment. They override collection and global variables with the same name.

delete.title: Delete Environment
delete.message: The {name} Environment and its {count, plural, one {# variable} other {# variables}} will be permanently deleted. It is deleted for everyone using this workspace.

variables.name: Name
variables.footnote: Use {token} in requests. If you leave the current value empty, the initial value is used. Put tokens and passwords in the current value, not the initial value; that way they are not sent to the server and not shared with the team.

errors.duplicate: The variable "{name}" is defined more than once.
